note: Curated national scholarship reference data for Compass. Amounts and eligibility are the sponsors' published terms as understood when this file was compiled; deadlines are stored as the month the program TYPICALLY closes, never an asserted date, because these move every cycle. Every entry carries the sponsor's own URL, which is the only authority. Awards that have been discontinued (AXA Achievement, Prudential Spirit of Community, Buick Achievers, Microsoft Tuition) are deliberately absent rather than left in as dead ends.

scholarships.name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
scholarships.summary: The best-known achievement award in the country: leadership and service across a long multi-stage read.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Opens in August and typically closes in late October of senior year.

scholarships.name: The Gates Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Covers the full cost of attendance not already met by other aid — the largest award most students will ever see.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes mid-September; requires Pell eligibility.

scholarships.name: QuestBridge National College Match
scholarships.summary: Not a check but a match: high-achieving, low-income seniors are placed at partner colleges on a full four-year scholarship.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Application typically closes in late September, with match results in early December.

scholarships.name: Jack Kent Cooke Foundation College Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Up to $55,000 a year for four years, plus advising — the most generous per-student award for high-achieving students with financial need.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes in mid-to-late November of senior year.

scholarships.name: Horatio Alger National Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Written for students who have pushed through real adversity; the GPA bar is deliberately low and the story carries the application.
scholarships.deadlineNote: National program typically closes in late October; state awards follow in the spring.

scholarships.name: National Merit Scholarship
scholarships.summary: You enter by taking the PSAT/NMSQT in junior year — there is no separate application, and many colleges stack their own money on top of Finalist status.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Entry is the October PSAT/NMSQT of JUNIOR year — the one deadline on this list you cannot make up later.

scholarships.name: Elks Most Valuable Student Scholarship
scholarships.summary: 500 four-year awards, and you do not need any connection to the Elks to apply — unusually good odds for a national program.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes in mid-November.

scholarships.name: Dell Scholars Program
scholarships.summary: Rewards grit over grades — a 2.4 GPA qualifies — and keeps supporting you with a laptop, textbook credits, and staff you can call after you enroll.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes December 1; usually requires participation in an approved college-readiness program.

scholarships.name: Burger King Scholars
scholarships.summary: Thousands of awards a year at a 2.5 GPA bar — one of the highest-volume national programs there is.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in October and closes in mid-December.

scholarships.name: Ron Brown Scholar Program
scholarships.summary: $10,000 a year for four years plus a lifelong network, for Black students with academic and community leadership.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Early deadline typically in November, final deadline in January.

scholarships.name: Jackie Robinson Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Four years of funding wrapped in mentoring and a leadership program — the support is as much the point as the money.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes in February of senior year.

scholarships.name: HSF Scholar Award
scholarships.summary: One application puts you in front of the largest Hispanic scholarship pipeline in the country, plus its career programming.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in December and closes in mid-February.

scholarships.name: UNCF General Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A single profile feeds dozens of UNCF-administered programs, so one submission is screened against many awards.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Individual programs open and close throughout the year — check the portal every few months.

scholarships.name: APIA Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Prioritizes students who are the first in their family to attend college and those from underrepresented AAPI communities.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in the autumn and closes in January.

scholarships.name: Full Circle Scholarship
scholarships.summary: One application covers the fund's whole scholarship catalogue, including awards specific to tribes and to majors.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes at the end of May for the following academic year.

scholarships.name: Point Foundation Flagship Scholarship
scholarships.summary: The national LGBTQ scholarship, pairing funding with mentorship and a leadership community.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes in late January.

scholarships.name: Coolidge Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A full ride — tuition, room, board, expenses — awarded on academic merit and an interest in public policy. Apply in JUNIOR year.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Junior-year application, typically closing in late January.

scholarships.name: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Judges a significant piece of work you have already produced — research, a portfolio, a build — rather than a résumé.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes in mid-February; the project itself takes months, so start in junior year.

scholarships.name: Regeneron Science Talent Search
scholarships.summary: The oldest science competition in the US: an original research project, with awards from $25,000 up to $250,000.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes in early-to-mid November — the research must be finished before then.

scholarships.name: Cameron Impact Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Full tuition to any accredited four-year US college, with no need requirement at all.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Opens in the spring of junior year and typically closes in September.

scholarships.name: GE-Reagan Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.summary: $10,000 a year, renewable for four — one of the largest merit awards with a reachable 3.0 GPA bar.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in November and closes in early January.

scholarships.name: Hagan Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Up to $60,000 for students from rural and small-town public high schools, with a study-abroad stipend built in.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes December 1. Only students at eligible rural/small-town public high schools may apply — check the school list first.

scholarships.name: Amazon Future Engineer Scholarship
scholarships.summary: $40,000 over four years plus a paid Amazon internship, for students heading into computer science.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in the autumn and closes in January.

scholarships.name: Generation Google Scholarship
scholarships.summary: $10,000 for students pursuing computer science who are from groups underrepresented in the field.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically closes in December; check the page each autumn, as Google reshuffles its programs.

scholarships.name: SWE Scholarship
scholarships.summary: One application is screened against hundreds of SWE awards for women entering engineering, computing, and engineering technology.
scholarships.deadlineNote: The incoming-freshman cycle typically runs in the spring, separate from the autumn cycle for current students.

scholarships.name: NSBE Scholarships
scholarships.summary: A portfolio of corporate-sponsored awards for Black students in engineering and technical fields.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Individual sponsor awards close on their own dates, mostly between December and March.

scholarships.name: SHPE Scholarship Program
scholarships.summary: STEM awards for Hispanic students, with membership opening the door to a national conference and recruiting pipeline.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in the winter and closes in the spring.

scholarships.name: McDonald's HACER National Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Up to $100,000 for Hispanic students, with a 2.8 GPA bar that keeps it genuinely open.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in the autumn and closes in early February.

scholarships.name: Live Más Scholarship
scholarships.summary: No GPA, no essay, no test scores — a two-minute video about what drives you. The lowest-friction real award on this list.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens after the new year and closes in late January or February.

scholarships.name: Dr Pepper Tuition Giveaway
scholarships.summary: A pitch video, then a football-field throw-off for up to $100,000. Unserious in form, entirely real in payout.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Runs alongside the college football season, typically closing in October.

scholarships.name: Voice of Democracy
scholarships.summary: A recorded audio essay on a patriotic theme. It advances post → district → state → national, so most entrants who place win something local.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Entries are typically due to a local VFW post by October 31.

scholarships.name: American Legion Oratorical Contest
scholarships.summary: A speech on the Constitution, judged from the local post upward — every round you survive pays.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Local rounds usually run from late autumn into January; departments set their own dates.

scholarships.name: DAR Scholarships
scholarships.summary: Dozens of small-to-mid awards, many by major or state, and most open to any US citizen — no lineage needed.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Most DAR awards close in mid-February; a few run on their own dates.

scholarships.name: Leaders and Achievers Scholarship
scholarships.summary: $2,500 awarded to over a thousand seniors a year — but your school has to nominate you, so ask your counselor in the autumn.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Nomination-only, typically closing in December. Only available where Comcast operates.

scholarships.name: Foot Locker Scholar Athletes
scholarships.summary: $20,000 for students who play a sport and lead off the field — the athletics do not have to be varsity-level.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in December and closes in January.

scholarships.name: Simon Youth Community Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Awarded by community, in every market with a Simon mall — a far smaller applicant pool than the national programs.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in January and closes in late February.

scholarships.name: RMHC Scholarships
scholarships.summary: Chapter-administered awards, so your competition is your metro area rather than the country.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Chapters set their own dates; most close between December and February.

scholarships.name: Optimist International Essay Contest
scholarships.summary: A single essay, judged club-first. Small money, but the local pool is often a few dozen people.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Clubs set their own dates, generally in the winter and early spring.

scholarships.name: Doodle for Google
scholarships.summary: One drawing on a yearly theme, for a $30,000 scholarship plus a technology grant to your school.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in the winter and closes in the spring.

scholarships.name: Army ROTC National Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Full tuition or room and board, plus a monthly stipend, in exchange for a service commitment after graduation.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Boards convene through the autumn and winter; applying to an early board improves your odds. Carries a service obligation.

scholarships.name: NROTC Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Full tuition at your chosen NROTC-affiliated college, with engineering and nursing tracks funded most heavily.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Applications typically close in January of senior year. Carries a service obligation.

scholarships.name: AFCEA STEM Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A cluster of STEM awards with a much smaller applicant pool than the household-name programs.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Most awards close in the spring; individual programs vary.

scholarships.name: Heisman High School Scholarship
scholarships.summary: For senior athletes with a 3.0 GPA; school, state, and national rounds each carry recognition and awards.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Typically opens in August and closes in October.

scholarships.name: Youth of the Year
scholarships.summary: Club members compete from local through national level, with scholarship money attached at each stage.
scholarships.deadlineNote: Local clubs select in the winter; you must be an active member to compete.

scholarships.name: Federal Pell Grant
scholarships.summary: Not a competition at all — money you qualify for by filing the FAFSA. For most students with need this is the single largest sum on the page, and it unlocks eligibility for several scholarships listed here.
scholarships.deadlineNote: File the FAFSA as soon as it opens for your cycle — the federal deadline is late, but state and college deadlines are far earlier and some aid is first-come.
